title: Agentic discrete-event simulation for manufacturing system design: an open 3D simulator, a benchmark and an industrial case
abstract: arXiv:2611.10602v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The design of manufacturing systems relies on discrete-event simulation (DES) models that experts still build in tool-specific interfaces. AI agents can now write simulation code, but every model they write from scratch is new, unverified software. We present SimuLean, an open-source 3D DES simulator on the Unity engine designed to be programmed by AI agents: its modelling semantics are verified once, in the platform, and the agent builds and studies one model through domain-level commands, in the 3D scene or headless; physically simulated durations are calibrated for fast headless studies. We evaluated it on 18 manufacturing modelling tasks, from single machines to published production lines. translated_title: 面向制造系统设计的智能体离散事件仿真：一个开源3D仿真器、一个基准测试和一个工业案例
translated_abstract: 制造系统的设计依赖于离散事件仿真（DES）模型，而专家们目前仍在使用特定工具的界面来构建这些模型。AI智能体现在可以编写仿真代码，但它们从头编写的每个模型都是新的、未经校验的软件。我们提出了SimuLean，一个基于Unity引擎的开源3D离散事件仿真器，专为AI智能体编程而设计：其建模语义在平台内被一次性校验，智能体通过领域级命令在3D场景中或无头模式下构建和研究一个模型；物理仿真的时长经过校准，以支持快速的无头研究。我们在18个制造建模任务上对其进行了评估，范围从单台机器到已发表的生产线。一个前沿智能体在108次尝试中成功构建了93个有效模型（86%），每个模型约需两分钟；在基准测试的接口版本上，两个前沿智能体仅通过领域命令就构建了108个模型中的105个，因此每个模型都附有构建过程的记录
tldr: 本文提出了SimuLean——一个基于Unity的开源3D离散事件仿真器，专为AI智能体编程设计，通过一次性校验的建模语义和领域级命令，使前沿AI智能体能以86%的成功率在约两分钟内自动构建有效的制造系统仿真模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SimuLean, an open-source Unity-based 3D discrete-event simulator designed for AI agent programming, which enables frontier agents to build valid manufacturing simulation models in about two minutes each with an 86% success rate through once-verified modeling semantics and domain-level commands.
